newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish economy ministry welcomes rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Spanish economy ministry welcomes rate cut.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry on Thursday welcomed a 50 basis point cut in the Bank of Spain's key money rate to 6.75 percent, saying it reflected market confidence in the conservative government's economic policy.

"This decision ... confirms the lower trend in interest rates, which reflects market confidence in the combination of liberalising, budget and monetary policies aimed at controlling inflation," the ministry said in a statement.
"This decision is good news for all Spaniards and will contribute towards strengthening the climate of trust and credibility of our economy in the process of European convergence," it added.
